scripts.build: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/agent-dashboard run build
scripts.build:full: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.vercel-build: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/agent-dashboard run build
scripts.test:security: pnpm --filter @workspace/agent-dashboard run test:security && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run test:security
scripts.test:data-correctness: pnpm --filter @workspace/agent-dashboard run test:data-correctness && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run test:data-correctness
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
